items.title: 9.2 Cybersecurity ka shaoor aur khatron ka intizam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cybersecurity awareness and threat management (PDF 125-128).

blocks.text: Cybersecurity ka shaoor ka matlab samajhna hai ke computers, networks aur data ko hamlon se kaise bachayein. Jaise jaise log technology par zyada inhisar karte hain, cyber khatre aam ho gaye hain; hackers maloomat churane ya systems kharab karne ke liye chaalein aur nuqsandeh software use karte hain. Khatre pehchanna, rokna aur jawab dena zaati aur idarati data mehfooz rakhta hai: maslan antivirus software install karein, aur online banking ya doosre hassas kaam ke liye public Wi-Fi se bachein.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Na-shaista zaban, spam aur raaz ki maloomat share karne se bachein.

Cyber khatre aise amal ya programs hain jo maloomat churane, systems kharab karne ya khidmat rokne ke liye computers aur networks ko nishana banate hain. In ka tareeqa-e-kaar samajhna users ko ibtidai alamat pehchanne deta hai; zyada tar hamle mehfooz browsing, antivirus software aur emails aur links mein ehtiyat se roke ja sakte hain. Khatre pehchanna hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Phishing sab se aam hamlon mein se hai.

blocks.caption: Cyber hamlon ki aam qismein
rows: Mutasira files se phailta aur data kharab ya delete kar sakta
Jaali emails, messages ya websites logon ko dhoke se passwords ya zaati tafseel dene par majboor karti
Files ya systems band kar ke kholne ke liye paisa mangta
Chupke se user ki maloomat jama karta
Bohat se computers se website par traffic ki bharmar kar ke use crash karta

blocks.text: Cyber hamle afraad ko, jo files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte hain, aur idaron ko, jinhein data breach, rukay kaam, gahakon ka khoya bharosa, kharab saakh aur maali nuqsan ho sakta hai, dono ko nuqsan pohanchate hain. Schools aur hospitals bhi mutasir ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch cards: Virus (mutasira files se phail kar data kharab), Phishing (jaali email ya website se password ki chori), Ransomware (data band, paisay ki maang), Spyware (chupke se maloomat jama), DDoS (website par itna bojh ke crash). Neeche 'Nuqsan kis ko?': afraad files, passwords ya paisa kho sakte; idaron ko data breach, rukay kaam, bharosa, saakh aur maali nuqsan.
blocks.caption: Cyber hamlon ki paanch qismein aur un ka nuqsan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

items: Two-factor authentication (2FA): rasai se pehle do tasdeeqein, maslan password aur phir phone ya email par aaya code. Sirf chori ka password kafi nahi rehta.
Biometric tasdeeq: fingerprints, chehre ka scan ya awaz jaisi jismani khusoosiyat shanakht tasdeeq karti hain.
Firewall: computer aur Internet ke darmiyan deewar jo mehfooz data guzarne aur nuqsandeh traffic rokne deti.
Intrusion detection system (IDS): network par mashkook sargarmi dekh kar users ko mumkina khatron se aagah karta.
Antivirus software: files scan kar ke viruses aur doosra malware nuqsan se pehle hatata.

blocks.alt: Beech mein 'Aap ka data' (taale ke saath), us se chaar dabbe jure: Firewall (nuqsandeh traffic roke), IDS (mashkook amal par khabar), Antivirus (virus aur malware hataye), 2FA aur biometrics (shanakht ki tasdeeq). Koi tarteeb nahi; sab mil kar kaam karte hain.
blocks.caption: Security ke tools mil kar data bachate hain (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.alt: Teen qadam upar se neeche: 1. Password (pehli tasdeeq); 2. Phone ya email par aaya code (doosri tasdeeq), phone ke nishan ke saath; phir 'Account khul gaya', dono sahi hon to hi rasai. Neeche: sirf chori ka password kafi nahi.
blocks.caption: Two-factor authentication (2FA) ke qadam (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Doosre qadam (ustad ka code) ke saath account mein login ki naqal karein taake samajh aaye ke 2FA kaise kaam karti hai.

Data ki hifazat ka matlab digital maloomat ko be-ijazat rasai, zaya ya nuqsan se bachana hai, taake sirf sahi log use dekh ya use kar sakein. Cryptography maloomat ko is tarah mehfooz karne ka ilm hai ke sirf ijazat yafta users samajh sakein. Encryption key ki madad se parhne ke qabil data ko coded text mein badalti hai; decryption zaroorat par use wapas badalti hai. Raste mein pakra gaya encrypted paigham na-qabil-e-parhai hota hai, is liye cryptography mehfooz websites, online banking aur messaging apps mein use hoti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Mehfooz storage aur muntaqili be-ijazat rasai aur data breach rokti hain.

blocks.alt: Upar se neeche: HELLO (parhne ke qabil data, plaintext) se teer 'Encryption (key se)' KHOOR (coded matn, ciphertext) tak, phir teer 'Decryption (key se)' wapas HELLO tak. KHOOR se aik dotted teer 'raaste mein pakarne wale' tak jo sirf KHOOR dekhta hai.
blocks.caption: Key se encryption aur decryption (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh aik chhoti si misal hai: har harf ko alphabet mein teen qadam aage kar diya (H se K, E se H, L se O), yani yahan key 3 hai. Asal systems is se kahin lambi khufia keys aur mazboot riyazi tareeqe use karte hain. Asal baat wahi hai jo kitab kehti hai: key ke baghair raaste mein pakarne wala coded matn parh nahi sakta.

Data ki hifazat dono waqt zaroori hai, jab mehfooz ho aur jab bheja jaye. HTTPS jaise encrypted connections raste mein data bachate, cloud storage services mehfooz files encrypt karti, aur baqaida backups system ki kharabi ya hamle se zaya hone se bachate hain.

Dakhal-andazi (intrusion) computer ya network tak be-ijazat rasai hai, aksar kisi kamzori ke zariye. Vulnerabilities software, hardware ya user ke rawaiye ki kamzoriyan hain; ibtidai alamat mein achanak susti, na-maloom programs aur ajeeb network traffic shamil hain. System logs jaanchna aur scanning tools in alamat ko jaldi pakarte hain. Masla milne par troubleshooting us ki wajah dhoondti hai, phir hifazati iqdamat: firewalls, antivirus aur anti-malware, software update, passwords badalna, nuqsandeh files hatana aur zaroorat ho to backups se data bahal karna. Masle aur hal ko likhna use dobara hone se rokne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Namoone ke system logs ya screenshots dekh kar mashkook amal dhoondein.

blocks.prompt: Aap ko email aati hai: 'Aap ka bank account band hai. Yahan click kar ke 1 ghante mein apna PIN dalein.' Yeh kis qism ka hamla hai, aur aap ko kya karna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Phishing: yeh jaldi ka dabao dalti aur link ke zariye khufia tafseel mangti hai. Click ya jawab na dein; bank se us ke sarkari number ya app se rabta karein, email report kar ke delete karein. Banks kabhi email se PIN nahi mangte.

items: Khatre: virus, phishing, ransomware, spyware, DDoS; log aur idare mutasir.
Cryptography: key se encryption aur decryption; HTTPS aur encrypted storage; kamzoriyan dekhein, troubleshoot aur bachao.
